name: Magnetic Leather Sunglass Holder
description:
FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Crafted from high-quality PU leather, this sunglass holder offers a soft, durable, and elegant finish. The inner lining ensures your glasses and cards stay scratch-free, while the strong magnetic closure provides secure storage.

 

  • Available 5 Colors: Black, Ivory, Gray Delight, Bordeaux, Chocolate Brown

Choose the color that matches your car interior or your personal style!

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions:

- Total Length: 9.5 cm ~ 3.74 in

- Holder Body: 6.6 cm ~ 2.6 in

- Width: 4.8 cm ~ 1.89 in

- Clip Width: 3.8 cm ~ 1.5 in

- Magnetic Flap Width: 1.4 cm ~ 0.55 in

- Compact and lightweight, it fits seamlessly on most standard car sun visors without obstructing your view.

 

  • Printing Technology:

- UV Printing: Vivid and high-resolution images with exceptional clarity.

  • Printing Surface Options:

- Single-side printing (Front Pad - Outer Surface): This is the main surface.

- Double-side printing: Printed on the main surface and one of two inner magnetic flap surfaces.

- Triple-surface printing: Printed on the main surface and two inner magnetic flap surfaces.

  • Perfect for custom branding, personalized designs, names, or gift messages.

 

  • Functional & Usage:

Multifunctional Storage: Securely holds sunglasses, eyeglasses, credit/bank cards, parking tickets, and receipts.

  • Easy Installation:

- STEP 1: Clip the holder onto your car’s sun visor.

- STEP 2: Open the magnetic clip.

- STEP 3: Place your glasses or items inside.

- STEP 4: Close the magnetic flap to secure.

Magnetic Mechanism: Strong grip with one-hand operation and no damage to your items.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

- With its sleek design and versatile functionality, this sunglass holder makes a thoughtful and practical gift for: Birthdays, Holidays, Graduations, Father's/Mother's Day, Corporate giveaways

- Suitable for men, women, and drivers of all ages.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Magnetic Leather Sunglass Holder

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
